review:
The trickster god across six Megaways reels, in various disguises. The Loki Super Symbol can transform into high-paying symbols during tumbles, keeping wins rolling.

Free spins trigger when you spell LOKI with four or more scatters, giving nine to 18 spins, and Loki can add more by turning symbols wild. Spelling the trigger makes it feel more interactive than a plain scatter count. 96.51% RTP.
